title: Solo Leveling
synopsis: Sung Jin-Woo, the weakest E-rank hunter, gains a unique system that lets him level up infinitely, transforming from prey into the most powerful hunter in the world.
review: An absolute page-turner. The progression system and escalating stakes make every arc feel earned. The art improves dramatically over time, reaching jaw-dropping levels in the final chapters.

title: Friern: Beyond Journey's End
synopsis: Two brothers search for the Philosopher's Stone to restore their bodies after a forbidden alchemy ritual goes wrong, uncovering a vast conspiracy along the way.
review: A masterclass in storytelling. Every plot thread is resolved, every character matters. The emotional payoff is unmatched in anime.

title: Berserk
synopsis: Guts, a lone mercenary with a tragic past, wages war against former friend Griffith and the godhand that cursed him, in a brutal dark fantasy world.
review: Miura's artwork is some of the finest ever put to page. The story is harrowing, beautiful, and deeply human despite its monstrous setting.

title: Attack on Titan
synopsis: Humanity lives behind walls to protect themselves from man-eating Titans, but the truth about the world is far more complex and devastating than anyone imagined.
review: Incredible plotting and foreshadowing. The way the mystery unfolds and the moral questions it raises in the final seasons elevate it beyond typical action anime.

title: The Beginning After The End
synopsis: A powerful king reincarnates into a magical world as a baby, retaining his memories. He navigates childhood while building toward an extraordinary new life.
review: Great world-building and character growth. The art is consistently gorgeous. The pacing dips in the middle but recovers strongly.

title: Vinland Saga
synopsis: A young Viking warrior named Thorfinn seeks revenge against the mercenary who killed his father, but his journey leads him to question the cycle of violence.
review: The character development from the Prologue to the Farmland arc is some of the best in manga. Thorfinn's transformation is profoundly moving.

title: Oshi no Ko
synopsis: A doctor and his patient are reincarnated as the twin children of a beloved idol, navigating the dark underbelly of the entertainment industry.
review: A brilliant blend of industry critique and supernatural mystery. The first arc is a perfect hook. The genre-switching keeps things fresh.

title: Demon Slayer
synopsis: Tanjiro Kamado becomes a demon slayer after his family is slaughtered and his sister turned into a demon, seeking a cure while battling powerful foes.
review: Ufotable's animation is simply the best in the industry. The story is straightforward but executed with incredible emotional resonance.

title: Tower of God
synopsis: A boy named Bam enters a mysterious tower to find his friend, climbing floors that test strength, intelligence, and willpower against other climbers.
review: Massive and creative world with deep lore. The early seasons are peak webtoon storytelling. The art starts rough but evolves beautifully.

title: Steins;Gate
synopsis: A self-proclaimed mad scientist accidentally discovers time travel, leading to a desperate struggle to save his friends from the consequences of altering the past.
review: Slow burn that pays off enormously. The second half is one of the most gripping narratives in anime. The emotional weight is crushing.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen
synopsis: Yuji Itadori swallows a cursed finger and joins a secret organization of jujutsu sorcerers to eliminate a powerful curse named Ryomen Sukuna.
review: Fantastic power system and some of the best fight choreography in manga. Gege's willingness to subvert expectations keeps you on edge.

title: Vagabond
synopsis: Based on the life of legendary swordsman Miyamoto Musashi, the story follows his journey from a brutal fighter to a man seeking the meaning of true strength.
review: Inoue's art is transcendent. Every panel is a painting. The philosophical depth elevates it beyond any battle manga.

title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint
synopsis: When the world transforms into the setting of a web novel only Kim Dokja read to completion, he uses his unique knowledge to survive and protect his companions.
review: One of the most clever narrative structures in manhwa. The meta-commentary on storytelling is brilliant, and the character bonds are deeply emotional.

title: Hunter x Hunter
synopsis: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter and find his father, encountering friends, foes, and a deep power system along the way.
review: The nen system is the gold standard for power systems in anime. The Chimera Ant arc is one of the greatest storylines ever animated.

title: Made in Abyss
synopsis: A young girl and a robot boy descend into a vast, deadly abyss searching for her mother, facing terrifying creatures and the abyss's curse.
review: Beautiful art hiding a deeply unsettling story. The world-building is incredible and the emotional gut-punches never miss.

title: Wind Breaker
synopsis: A studious boy discovers a passion for cycling and joins a competitive team, finding friendship and purpose through the sport.
review: Surprisingly engaging sports manhwa with great character dynamics. The racing sequences are dynamic and exciting.

title: Chainsaw Man
synopsis: Denji, a young man burdened by debt, merges with his chainsaw devil dog Pochita and becomes a devil hunter for the government.
review: Fujimoto's unpredictable storytelling is refreshing. It's crude, hilarious, and surprisingly profound. The art is kinetic and visceral.

title: Mushishi
synopsis: Ginko travels across Japan studying mushi, ethereal creatures that exist between the natural and supernatural worlds, helping people affected by them.
review: A meditative, atmospheric masterpiece. Each episode is a self-contained story that lingers long after watching. The soundtrack is sublime.

title: Star-Embracing Swordmaster
synopsis: Kisah perjuangan seorang pemuda dari kalangan paling bawah yang berusaha menjadi ksatria sejati dengan bumbu cerita romance tipis.
review: Goated! Perjalanan MC dari zero to hero dapet banget, tema ksatrianya berasa kental dan aksinya sangat solid.

title: Swordmaster’s Youngest Son
synopsis: Anak bungsu klan ksatria pedang terkuat yang mendapatkan kesempatan kedua untuk mengulang hidupnya dan mencapai puncak kekuatan.
review: Konsepnya mirip kaya Baskerville. Udah 200+ chapter tapi power level MC berasa ga sekuat itu, jadi agak kurang masuk di selera.

title: The Heavenly Demon Can’t Live a Normal Life
synopsis: Iblis Surgawi terkuat dari dunia Murim berpindah jiwa ke tubuh bangsawan penakut di dunia fantasi bermagic.
review: Eksplorasi dari murim ke dunia magic yang seru. MC-nya sangat dominan dan fokus build pasukannya sendiri dari nol.

title: Mercenary Enrollment
synopsis: Seorang mantan tentara bayaran elit yang selamat dari kecelakaan pesawat kembali ke kampung halaman untuk hidup sebagai anak SMA biasa bersama keluarganya.
review: Kisah veteran tentara bayaran yang OP mampus tapi mendadak harus adaptasi jadi anak sekolah demi melindungi keluarganya.

title: Standard of Reincarnation
synopsis: Dilahirkan tanpa bakat di klan ksatria bergengsi dan dikhianati, sang MC reinkarnasi untuk menuntut balas.
review: Sangat dramatis. Alurnya agak berliku, tapi seru karena perjuangan MC-nya kelihatan tersiksa banget mirip Asta dari Black Clover.

title: The Great Mage Returns After 4000 Years
synopsis: Penyihir terkuat yang terkurung di jurang neraka selama 4000 tahun bangkit kembali di tubuh seorang murid akademi yang lemah.
review: Meskipun mengusung template reinkarnasi, skema serta konsep sihir yang dihadirkan di manhwa ini seru banget buat diikuti.

title: I Obtained a Mythic Item
synopsis: Seorang raider kelas rendah secara tidak sengaja mendapatkan item tingkat Mitos yang memungkinkan dirinya meregresi waktu.
review: Mengusung tema hunter regresi ala Solo Leveling. Ceritanya lumayan seru tapi sempat didrop pas chapter 50-an.

title: The Count’s Youngest Son is a Player
synopsis: Anak bungsu bangsawan yang diremehkan mendapatkan akses sistem player untuk meningkatkan kekuatannya.
review: Sekitar 40 chapter awal sangat bagus dan menjanjikan, sayang makin ke sini MC-nya makin kena powercreep.

title: Player Who Returned 10,000 Years Later
synopsis: Manusia yang terjebak di neraka selama puluhan ribu tahun hingga menjadi Raja Iblis akhirnya menemukan cara untuk pulang ke Bumi.
review: Penuh komedi kocak! Raja iblis bosenan yang balik ke bumi cuma buat makan ramen dan jadi hunter. Sangat cocok dibaca pas gabut.

title: Regressor Instruction Manual
synopsis: Di dunia tempat orang-orang dipanggil untuk bertahan hidup, sang MC memanfaatkan pemegang kemampuan regresi menggunakan keahlian manipulasi dan taktiknya.
review: MC tidak OP fisik tapi pinter scheming dan manipulatif. Ceritanya bagus meski ada sedikit unsur gay-bait buat narik pembaca.

title: I Became the Tyrant of a Defense Game
synopsis: Gamer ahli strategi berpindah ke dalam game Tower Defense paling mustahil dan harus memimpin garis depan untuk bertahan dari monster.
review: Seru abis! Rasanya mirip Attack on Titan versi tower defense. MC-nya sangat pintar mengambil keputusan sebagai komandan perang.

title: I Was More Overpowered Than the Hero, So I Hid My Power
synopsis: MC yang jauh lebih kuat dari pahlawan memilih untuk menyembunyikan kekuatan aslinya dan bertindak dari balik layar.
review: Berasa kayak Cid Kagenou versi manhwa. Kualitas gambarnya tergolong standar/kurang, tapi tetap menghibur buat dibaca.

title: Overgeared
synopsis: Seorang gamer bernasib sial menemukan quest tersembunyi yang mengubah kelasnya menjadi Pande Besi Legendaris.
review: Secara umum kurang begitu direkomendasikan karena eksekusinya, tapi masih tergolong lumayan seru untuk dinikmati.

title: Transcension Academy
synopsis: Seorang pencari kerja biasa yang terlilit hutang mendapatkan undangan masuk ke akademi khusus para dewa dan pahlawan legendaris.
review: Mengikuti pola dan formula template hunter Korea pada umumnya.

title: Second Life Ranker
synopsis: Membalas dendam atas kematian saudara kembar identiknya, sang MC memanjat Menara Dewa Matahari menggunakan jam tangan peninggalan adiknya.
review: PEAKKK! Penulisan ceritanya sangat bagus, aksi dan pertimbangan tindakan MC-nya rasional dan tidak sekadar OP ngasal.

title: Reformation of the Deadbeat Noble
synopsis: Seorang pemuda pemalas yang sering bermimpi tentang seorang pria yang mengayunkan pedang selama bertahun-tahun mulai bangkit untuk berlatih.
review: Storyline luar biasa dan wajib dibaca! Tema kerja keras serta proses perkembangan karakternya terasa sangat memuaskan.

title: Superhuman Battlefield
synopsis: Pahlawan terkuat yang menyelamatkan dunia dari kepunahan terbangun 17 tahun kemudian di mana kekuatan super telah diubah menjadi olahraga esports.
review: Turnamen antar pahlawan super yang dikemas seperti olahraga esport profesional. Wajib dibaca sampai tamat.

title: Return to Player
synopsis: Manusia terakhir yang bertahan hidup di akhir permainan para dewa mendapatkan kesempatan kedua untuk mengulang permainan dari awal.
review: Konsep dan art style-nya sangat mirip Solo Leveling versi liar, tapi suasana dunianya jauh lebih ketiadaan harapan dan chaos.

title: Damn Reincarnation
synopsis: Ksatria Hamel yang tewas saat bertualang menaklukkan Raja Iblis terlahir kembali sebagai keturunan dari saingannya, Vernos.
review: Peak story dan peak MC! Dinamika dunia fantasi dan rahasia masa lalunya dikemas dengan sangat bagus.

title: Seoul Station Druid
synopsis: Kembali ke Bumi setelah terdampar di dunia lain selama seribu tahun, sang MC menjadi Druid pertama di dunia yang dipenuhi dungeon.
review: Bagus kalau lagi nyari pembawaan cerita berkonsep necromancer/druid dengan pasukan makhluk magis.

title: Taming Master
synopsis: Seorang pro-player game VR meriset ulang karakternya demi mengambil kelas tersembunyi 'Taming Master'.
review: Konsep taming dan melatih hewan/monster peliharaan yang dikemas seru dan tidak membosankan.

title: The Beginning After the End
synopsis: Raja Grey yang kesepian di kehidupan lalunya terlahir kembali di dunia sihir sebagai Arthur Leywin untuk mengukir takdir baru.
review: Adaptasi manhwanya PEAK mampus di semua aspek cerita maupun eksekusi gambar visualnya.
